story: 規約の第八条。説明は一度きりで、断る方法は書かれていない。
点検の予告、シーツの回収、ゴミの量。部屋ごとの「管理の記録」が付けられていく。
「先月より溜まってますよね。顔でわかります」――月末の集金は、だんだん長くなる。
30日目。「今月分、まだもらってません」
storyEn: Article 8 of the lease. She explains it exactly once, and there is no clause about refusing.
Inspection notices, collected sheets, the amount of trash. A "management record" starts filling up for each room.
"You've built up more than last month. I can tell from your face." The end-of-month collection takes longer every time.
Day 30: "I still haven't received this month's."
